audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike and the mid paragraph describe her spike without a single cooldown number, so 'fight when her mist is down' is unactionable.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s and Needlework 120/100/80s — the 22s rank-1 mist timer is the number that decides when Irelia may commit.
audit.corrected: The mist's 22s rank-1 cooldown written into mid and into Key Ability Interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields call Gwen 'untargetable' inside Hallowed Mist. Riot's W text says she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist — she is untargetable from outside, not untargetable outright, and stepping into the mist restores targeting. The R is also written as 'Needle Work' in three places; the real name is Needlework.
audit.why: An Irelia told Gwen is flatly untargetable will never step in and finish a kill she could have taken; the distinction is the whole mist interaction.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[2], mid and Key Ability Interactions now say she is only targetable from inside the mist, and the R is spelled Needlework throughout those fields.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your peak skirmish window: your Bladesurge stacks ramp your on-hit shred and your cooldowns are tight, so a clean E-stun-into-reset chain out-trades her here. But at 6 the lane flips — Needle Work (R) plus Hallowed Mist let her go untargetable to your autos and step out of your E range while her R waves chunk you. Once she has W and R up, only commit when her mist is on cooldown or you've baited it; otherwise you whiff your whole combo into an untargetable target and trade into her healing.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your peak skirmish window: your Ionian Fervor stacks ramp your on-hit and your cooldowns are tight, so a clean E-stun-into-reset chain out-trades her here. But at 6 the lane flips — Needlework (R) plus Hallowed Mist mean she can only be hit by someone standing inside the mist, and her three needle waves chunk you as she steps out of E range. Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1: bait it or wait it out, because committing into it wastes your combo and feeds her passive healing.
